verdict.rationale: Hardware support and longevity on older machines is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation or hands-on reports showing that macOS installs on, or improves performance and lifespan of, older hardware. The only related items are community reports of slowdowns and hangs on Catalina, Mojave and a Hackintosh, which do not show this capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get better performance and extended device lifespan by installing the OS on older hardware
